topics.label: Lecture Introduction
topics.groupedBecause: It introduces the topic of the lecture and frames the scope and complexity of complement nomenclature.

topics.label: Overview of Complement and the Central Role of C3
topics.groupedBecause: They introduce the fundamental principles, historical naming conventions, and pivotal biochemical role of C3 in the complement system.

topics.label: Complement Activation Pathways
topics.groupedBecause: They detail the three distinct upstream pathways and threshold required to trigger complement activation on pathogen surfaces.

topics.label: Effector Mechanisms of Complement
topics.groupedBecause: They explain how activated complement eliminates pathogens and stimulates immunity through its downstream effector actions.

topics.label: Regulation of Complement and Host Protection
topics.groupedBecause: It details the regulatory proteins that prevent complement from damaging host cells.

topics.label: Clinical Complement Deficiencies
topics.groupedBecause: It outlines the distinct clinical manifestations and disease risks associated with deficiencies in various complement proteins.

topics.label: Pathogen Evasion of Complement
topics.groupedBecause: It describes the evolutionary mechanisms used by pathogens to subvert and resist complement-mediated clearance.

topics.label: Lecture Conclusion
topics.groupedBecause: It concludes the lecture and previews the upcoming topic on the adaptive immune system.
